mechanism_narrative: If WORKPLACES and TRANSIT continue to fall over the next four weeks, weekday foot traffic will keep weakening and RETAIL_REC will decline further relative to the last four weeks. The mechanism fails if workplace and transit mobility stabilize while retail still drops.

failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not improve within 7 days after RESIDENTIAL drops below +2 and PARKS moves above -10.
